visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A cartoon cat with orange stripes and a white belly is centered against a solid white background. The cat has its eyes squeezed tightly shut in an expression of frustration and strain, with its right paw clenched into a small fist. A large, tangled black scribble ball representing mental confusion is positioned directly above its head. Traditional Chinese and English text appears at the top. (2) The visual remains largely static, but the cat maintains its frustrated posture, slightly vibrating to suggest effort. The scribble ball remains active above its head. The text at the top of the frame changes to a second line, keeping the same centered alignment and black font color against the bright background. (3) The cat's expression suddenly shifts; its eyes open wide with a blank, surprised look before closing into a peaceful, content state with its mouth slightly agape. The scribble ball vanishes instantly, replaced by a single black question mark that also fades. New text appears at the top to deliver the punchline.
